title: Code review ignores explicit target worktree
details:
- **What happened:** Review was requested for current diff in fixed worktree `C:\ZYS\Code\dtsf-eam-11-lifecycle-approval`, but fork reviewed primary workspace `C:\ZYS\Code\dtsf-eam` and reported stale findings already fixed in target. Expected review to preserve explicit target working directory.
- **What the user said:** "不要创建新 worktree，不要操作其他 worktree。工作位置与基线：#11 worktree：C:\ZYS\Code\dtsf-eam-11-lifecycle-approval"
- **Repro:** Invoke `code-review` skill from primary workspace while task explicitly targets another existing worktree; inspect paths in result.
- **Evidence:** Target HEAD `0b4567e5`; review result cited `C:\ZYS\Code\dtsf-eam\code\backend-java\src\test\...`.
